preamble: This Coastal Solar Credit Placement Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of [__________], 2022 (the “Effective Date”), by and between Cascade Timber Holdings, Inc., an Oregon corporation with offices at 1200 Forest Park Way, Suite 900, Portland, Oregon 97209 (“Seller”), acting through Alder Point Partners, with offices in Sacramento, California, as administrator of the Coastal Solar Credit Program (“Administrator”), and [PURCHASER NAME], a [__________] with offices at [__________] (“Purchaser”).
recitals: Seller holds renewable energy tax credits issued under the Coastal Solar Credit Program (the “Program”) in respect of qualifying easement and solar-siting parcels (the “Credits”).
Administrator administers the Program on Seller's behalf, including eligibility screening, certificate issuance and placement of Credits with purchasers.
Purchaser wishes to purchase, and Seller wishes to sell, Credits in the face amount and at the price set forth in Schedule 1, on the terms of this Agreement.
content.recitals_close: NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants set forth herein, the parties agree as follows:

sections.heading: Definitions
text: “Face Amount” means the stated dollar value of a Credit as shown on its Credit Certificate. “Credit Certificate” means the certificate issued under the Program evidencing a Credit. “Program Documentation” means the Program description, eligibility screening materials, eligibility checklist and related materials prepared and furnished by Administrator. “Closing” means the date on which Purchaser pays the Purchase Price. [Additional definitions TBD.]

sections.heading: Purchase and Sale
text: Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Seller agrees to sell and Purchaser agrees to purchase Credits having the aggregate Face Amount set forth in Schedule 1.

sections.heading: Purchase Price
text: The purchase price for the Credits shall be {{price}} (the “Purchase Price”), payable by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account designated by Administrator at Closing.

sections.heading: Delivery of Credit Certificates
text: Within {{delivery_days}} business days after Closing, Administrator shall deliver to Purchaser Credit Certificates evidencing the Credits purchased, each identifying the certificate number, Program vintage and Face Amount. Title to the Credits passes to Purchaser upon delivery of the Credit Certificates.

sections.heading: Seller Representations
text: Seller represents that (a) it has the authority to enter into this Agreement; (b) the Credits are free of liens and have not been previously sold or assigned; and (c) {{elig_text}}

sections.heading: Purchaser Representations
text: Purchaser represents that it is acquiring the Credits for its own account, that it has had the opportunity to review the Program Documentation and to ask questions of Administrator, and that it has the authority to enter into this Agreement.

sections.heading: Notices
text: Notices shall be in writing and delivered to Administrator (Attn: Program Administration, Sacramento, California), with a copy to Seller at the address above, and to Purchaser at the address first written above.

sections.heading: Governing Law
text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of {{law}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

sections.heading: Miscellaneous
text: This Agreement, together with Schedule 1, is the entire agreement of the parties regarding its subject matter and may be amended only in a writing signed by Seller (or Administrator on its behalf) and Purchaser. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts.

content.signature_intro: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
